text: Geppetto held Pinocchio. <break time="0.8s" /> Under the arms. <break time="0.8s" /> And taught him how to walk. <break time="0.8s" /> Pinocchios legs were stiff. <break time="0.8s" /> At first. <break time="0.8s" /> But soon. <break time="0.8s" /> He was walking around the room. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly he jumped. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the open door. <break time="0.8s" /> And ran out into the street. <break time="0.8s" /> Catch him, Catch him. <break time="0.8s" /> Shouted Geppetto. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was running after him. <break time="0.8s" /> The people in the street. <break time="0.8s" /> Only laughed at the wooden puppet. <break time="0.8s" /> Which ran like a rabbit. <break time="0.8s" /> At last a policeman stood. <break time="0.8s" /> In the middle of the road. <break time="0.8s" /> And caught him by the nose. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto ran up. <break time="0.8s" /> And said. <break time="0.8s" /> You will come home with me now. <break time="0.8s" /> But Pinocchio threw himself. <break time="0.8s" /> On the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> And would not walk. <break time="0.8s" /> A crowd gathered. <break time="0.8s" /> And some people said. <break time="0.8s" /> That Geppetto was a cruel old man. <break time="0.8s" /> They thought. <break time="0.8s" /> He would treat the puppet badly. <break time="0.8s" /> When they got home. <break time="0.8s" /> So the policeman let Pinocchio go. <break time="0.8s" /> And took poor Geppetto. <break time="0.8s" /> To prison instead.
